issue_context.title: v1.3 beta1 - Remember new tilemap layer base index
issue_context.body:
In v1.3 beta1 I need to change the tile base index from 1 to 0 every time I create a new tilemap layer.

It'd be nice if either the new tilemap layer dialog remembered the last used value or there was a preferences setting to override the default value.

review_comments: I think we shouldn't save the grid width/height in preferences, as the current grid settings are used anyway (see `tilesetInfo.grid = context->activeSite().grid();` above) and I think we prefer that one as the default.

There is no need to call save() immediately here (`Preferences::save()` is called in `App::~App()` anyway and is the real function that saves to disk -or should be-)
